newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal closes mostly firm as September up.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal closes mostly firm as September up.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures closed mostly higher led by the nearby September contract amid ongoing lack of deliveries posted against that month, traders said.
Thursday is expiration for the CBOT September contracts, and the firm tone in those contracts Wednesday helped buoy prices in all pits, they said.

Gains in the soy complex were limited by follow-through technical selling, stiff worldwide competition for exports and U.S. Midwest weather outlooks indicating no threat of frost over the near term, they said.
Soymeal closed $1.10 per ton higher to $1.00 lower, with September up $1.10 at $274.90. Soyoil was down 0.16 to 0.29 cent per lb, with September off 0.16 at 25.15.

Soymeal futures volume was estimated 21,000 contracts, about the same as the 21,035 Wednesday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 17,000 contracts, up from 13,485 Wednesday.
